Experience supporting accelerator facilities, research/national laboratories, manufacturing, semiconductor, aerospace, utility, or other complex technical environments.

items.item_text: Candidates must be eligible to work in the U.S. at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
Experience supporting accelerator facilities, research/national laboratories, manufacturing, semiconductor, aerospace, utility, or other complex technical environments.
Experience with large-scale scientific, infrastructure, or multidisciplinary engineering projects.
Experience with AutoCAD Electrical, AutoCAD, OrCAD, KiCad, Altium, Windchill, or comparable systems.
Experience with configuration management, product lifecycle management, technical standards, procedures, workflows, or training development.
Experience providing technical leadership, mentoring, or direction to technical personnel, contractors, or vendors.
Independently lead complex technical assignments, systems, projects, and work packages from planning through implementation, testing, commissioning, documentation, and closeout.

Apply advanced technical expertise to the design, integration, operation, troubleshooting, testing, maintenance, modification, and modernization of electrical, electronic, control, instrumentation, and related systems.
Translate engineering requirements and project objectives into practical designs, work packages, installation requirements, test procedures, and technical documentation.
Select appropriate methods, tools, components, equipment, and technical solutions based on requirements, safety, reliability, maintainability, compatibility, lifecycle, and applicable standards.
Develop, interpret, review, and maintain schematics, wiring diagrams, one-lines, cable documentation, layouts, specifications, procedures, and as-built records.
Perform technical investigations, field evaluations, testing, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis to resolve complex technical issues and improve system performance and reliability.
Support fabrication, installation, integration, commissioning, startup, maintenance, modification, inspection, and acceptance activities.
Coordinate technical activities with engineers, Engineering Associates, technicians, trades personnel, scientists, project managers, contractors, vendors, and other stakeholders.
Support procurement through technical specifications, equipment requirements, vendor evaluations, submittals, inspections, and acceptance activities.
Monitor technical scope, schedules, deliverables, interfaces, risks, quality, and implementation issues, escalating concerns and coordinating additional expertise when needed.
Provide technical guidance, training, and mentoring to less experienced technical personnel.
Identify and implement improvements to technical processes, documentation, reliability, maintainability, safety, and project execution.
Apply Laboratory requirements, codes, standards, engineering practices, work-control processes, and applicable electrical and safety requirements.
